page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.13xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.g6 server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 52 dedicated vCPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per core. Virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It also lacks integrated GPU hardware accelerators and does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses. For network connectivity, the instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

The dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable compute performance for multi-threaded workloads. Given its balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance is configured for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, and application servers that require substantial compute capacity without the need for specialized GPU acceleration or local high-speed NVMe storage.
